notes.arroyo-vista: Arroyo Vista is the row of houses on Arroyo Drive (UCI Housing's Arroyo Vista office is 1000 Arroyo Dr, housing.uci.edu/about/contact; OSM maps the houses as 1006-1036 Arroyo Dr). Pinned to 1016 Arroyo Dr (way/1014678925), mid-row.
notes.verano-place: Verano Place is the graduate and family housing on Verano Road South and Adobe Circle (UCI Housing's office there is 6529 Adobe Circle Rd South, housing.uci.edu/about/contact). Pinned to OSM way/640643577, '2500 South Verano Road' (building=dormitory), in the middle of it.
